description:
## Problem

`HtmlExtractor#extract_all` (src/vug/html_extractor.cr, lines 41–69) manually implements retry logic with exponential backoff, sleep, and attempt counting. This duplicates the exact functionality already provided by `RetryHelpers.with_retry` (src/vug/retry_helpers.cr).

The module already supports:
- Configurable max_retries, base_delay, max_delay
- Retryable exception filtering (IO::TimeoutError, Socket::Error, IO::Error, OpenSSL::SSL::Error match the current rescue list)
- Exponential backoff with jitter via `backoff_delay`
- on_retry callback for logging

## Proposed Fix

Replace the manual loop with:

```crystal
RetryHelpers.with_retry(
  max_retries: max_retries,
  base_delay: base_delay,
  max_delay: max_delay,
  on_retry: ->(attempt : Int32, ex : Exception, delay : Time::Span) {
    @config.debug("Transient error on #{site_url}: #{ex.message}. Retrying in #{delay.total_milliseconds.round}ms...")
  }
) do
  client = @http_client_factory.create_client(uri, read_timeout)
  begin
    headers = build_html_headers
    result = [] of FaviconInfo
    client.get(uri.request_target, headers: headers) do |response|
      result = process_html_response(response, site_url)
    end
    result
  ensure
    client.try(&.close)
  end
end
```

This eliminates ~25 lines of duplicated retry mechanics and keeps the method focused on HTML extraction.

## Files
- src/vug/html_extractor.cr (primary)
- spec/vug/extractor_initialization_spec.cr (verify no regressions)
title: DRY: Replace hand-rolled retry loop in HtmlExtractor#extract_all with RetryHelpers.with_retry
